sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 per unit (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).
Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. While we note the recent decrease in the AS-14404 index, our material is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning these reductions do not currently lower our cost base. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, provided we implement an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term volatility. Incorporating this index clause allows us to revise our offer to €5.57 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our quote is a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
